ezra.5.p1.b2.text: … the prophets Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.

ezra.5.p1.b3.text: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak rose up and began to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem …

ezra.5.p1.b4.text: … the prophets of God were with them, helping them.

ezra.5.p2.b1.text: At that time Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates went to the Jews and asked …

ezra.5.p2.b2.text: Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?

ezra.5.p2.b3.text: They also asked, “What are the names of the men who are constructing this building?”

ezra.5.p2.b4.text: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, so that they were not stopped …

ezra.5.p3.b1.text: Let it be known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. The people are rebuilding it with large stones, and placing timbers in the walls. This work is being carried out diligently …

ezra.5.p3.b2.text: We are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago …

ezra.5.p3.b3.text: … from that time until now it has been under construction, but it has not yet been completed.

ezra.5.p3.b4.text: Now, therefore, if it pleases the king, let a search be made of the royal archives in Babylon … Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.
